fixtures._comment: sObject changed Account -> Lead at M8. What this fixture asserts is BOUNDEDNESS — a delete naming one Id is allowed where a WHERE-clause delete is not — and Account was incidental to that. Account is on the operator's protected list, and record-level deletion of a protected object now takes an approval, which gate_fixtures_r19.json pins in both directions. Leaving Account here would have made this fixture quietly assert the opposite of R19 and made whichever ran last the answer.
